scope: storage primitive MEASURED on this box; app-layer pending live iDempiere

storage.note: 1000 ops, one atomic group commit — storage only (no callouts/posting)
storage.teaches: On one box with no network, durable Postgres is FASTER per write than sql.js+hash-chain — the server is genuinely good at storage. We trade that speed for zero-server + a signed log. This is where our lead is smallest; we say so.

network_teaches: Add a round-trip per server op. Our column does not move — we have no server to reach. That flat line is the point: the network cost is entirely the server’s.

app_layer.op: create + complete an order (callouts + ModelValidator + posting)
app_layer.note: timed LIVE by the page when a local iDempiere REST answers; not booted at bake time

memory.source: documented JVM heap baseline before first user
